title: Single-Level Dictionary Entries

items.def: — Full-time duty in the active military service of the United States. See also **active duty for training; inactive duty training.**

print.printFeatures: Dictionary entry with a bold headword, an em-dash, and bold cross-references.

resolution: def text corrected: 'Full' needs no emphasis markup at all (its own capital F already yields the given braille's capital-letter indicator on its own); only the cross-reference TARGETS themselves ('active duty for training; inactive duty training'), not the introductory 'See also', are bold in the given braille (^7...^') — an earlier draft wrongly italicized 'Full' and bolded 'See also' too.
